note: Expanded cohort studies explicitly confirm recurrent preaxial hand abnormalities (such as thumb malformations and polydactyly) as a recognized feature of Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome.

evidence.text: In an expanded cohort of 24 additional unrelated patients with PSMD12 variants, preaxial hand abnormalities were confirmed as a recurrent feature of Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: In addition to previously reported DD/ID, speech delay, cardiac and renal anomalies, we also confirmed preaxial hand abnormalities as a feature of this syndrome.

evidence.text: Characterization of the PSMD12-related spectrum and literature review highlights hand anomalies and unilateral polydactyly among the recognized skeletal phenotypes.

source.title: Does It Run in Your Family? Inherited Truncating PSMD12 Variants Broaden the Phenotypic Spectrum of Stankiewicz‐Isidor Syndrome
